name: The Amendment Trap (Superseding Liability Cap)
query: What is the liability cap and termination notice period for Tier 2 enterprise customers?

documents.content: Master Services Agreement (2022): Section 4.1 Liability Cap. In no event shall Vendor aggregate liability exceed $1,000,000. Section 4.2 Termination: Either party may terminate with 30 days written notice.

Addendum No. 3 (Executed 2024, Supersedes Section 4 of 2022 MSA): For Tier 2 enterprise customers, the liability cap is increased to $2,500,000 and termination notice requirement is extended to 60 days.

name: The Multi-Hop Disconnect (Separated Appendix Definition)
query: What is the vesting schedule cliff for Group C executives under the equity plan?

documents.content: 2023 Executive Equity Incentive Plan: Section 2.4 Participant Classification. All Group C executive equity awards are strictly governed by the special vesting rules in Appendix IV.
Appendix IV (Group C Executive Provisions): Notwithstanding standard 1-year schedules, Group C executive options require a mandatory 3-year cliff before any shares vest.
